title: Cloud Infrastructure Management in the Age of AI Agents
publication_status: arXiv position/preliminary-study preprint; no peer-reviewed venue verified
license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; not a general third-party redistribution grant

evidence.finding: Preliminary Azure VM study compares SDK,CLI,Terraform and web agents for provisioning,updates,monitoring; different underlying models limit comparability.
Provisioning uses three VM tasks with eight trials per task; step counts are agent actions, not elapsed time.
Proposed architecture separates user-agent and agent-cloud interfaces; recommends unified state,locking,policy checks,audit trails,rollback and human supervision.
